verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's docs explicitly state JavaScript rendering is enabled by default via headless browsers, supports SPA frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, jQuery), can wait for CSS/XPath selectors before returning HTML, and supports JS scenarios for interacting with pages before extracting rendered HTML. This directly delivers the core story of rendering JS-heavy SPAs and returning fully rendered HTML. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of rendering fidelity beyond vendor docs.
